name: @adatechnology/crowd-test-area
description: Crowd area for the shared test room: a horde of the undead pack drawn on the instanced path (every type's variants baked by the Bestiário builder, three levels of detail, a few draw calls), the room's camera as the game-player body it hunts, civilians who follow and flee, the herd and the vultures drawn by game-animals-three, and a game-infection region that brings agents out and takes them back. The bench sets the count, the type, the night and the seed, makes a noise, shoots the nearest, kills all, and shows the agents, the levels of detail, the draw calls and the bake time. Nine scenarios check the rules.
